hypothesis: Applying one small, physically valid 3-D orientation perturbation per wrist consistently across that subject's activities and both sensor modalities will reduce axis-specific overfitting and improve cross-subject generalization.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Reject rotation augmentation if BA gain versus balanced-v3 is below 0.01 or if BA, AUROC, macro-F1 and DD recall do not improve coherently across folds.
